movie_title: Bad bosses make people quit: BBC News Review
introduction: Bad bosses make people quit. Almost one third of British workers in a recent study said they’d left

vocabulary.example: His poor performance at work prompted his boss to give him a warning.

vocabulary.definition: following rules and conventions, official or organized
vocabulary.example: The company requires all employees to wear formal attire during client meetings.

vocabulary.definition: gradually getting weaker or smaller due to continuous problems or attacks
vocabulary.example: The attrition rate at the company increased as employees started leaving for better opportunities.

vocabulary.definition: not producing the desired results, not successful
vocabulary.example: The new sales strategy proved to be ineffective in increasing profits.

vocabulary.definition: enthusiastic and driven to achieve goals
vocabulary.example: She is highly motivated to succeed in her career and is always eager to learn.

vocabulary.definition: happening by chance or unintentionally, without planning
vocabulary.example: He became an accidental hero when he saved the child from drowning in the pool.
